description: Self-hosted Renovate (.github/workflows/renovate.yml). Nothing merges itself: Argo CD deploys whatever lands on main. See docs/ci.md.

customManagers.description: Versions marked with a `# renovate:` comment on the line above (Ansible vars, workflow env)
Container images in Ansible role defaults (`<name>_image: repo:tag`, the Swarm stacks)

packageRules.description: Sources in this repo track main
One PR for all non-major GitHub Actions (and the Renovate image)
Terraform's own version constraint is a floor, not a pin
The Prometheus operator CRDs belong to the kube-prometheus-stack release
Alloy on the VMs follows the Alloy chart
prBodyNotes: Keep `alloy_version` (VMs) at the chart's appVersion. VMs pick it up with `make logs`.

packageRules.description: Release assets checked against a SHA-256 next to the version
prBodyNotes: **Checksum pinned:** update the matching `*_SHA256` / `*_sha256` value in this PR (from the release's checksums file). CI fails until it matches.
promtool must match the Prometheus that kube-prometheus-stack deploys: merge only together with that chart. Also bump the nixpkgs commit of `prometheus.cli` in devbox.json.
lokitool must match the Loki that the loki chart deploys: merge only together with that chart. Also bump the nixpkgs commit of `grafana-loki` in devbox.json.

packageRules.description: Installed by Ansible, not Argo CD
prBodyNotes: Applied by Ansible, not Argo CD: after merging run the playbook for it (Cilium/Gateway API: `make cilium`; kube-vip: `make k8s` on the control-plane nodes). Check the Cilium release notes for the supported Gateway API version and cilium-cli.
Swarm stack: after merging run `make alerting`.
Swarm stack edge: after merging run `make edge`. Traefik restarts one manager at a time; keepalived moves the VIP off each node while it restarts (docs/edge.md).
Swarm stack: after merging run `make uptime`. Uptime Kuma major versions migrate the database at start; AutoKuma must match the Uptime Kuma major (docs/uptime.md).

packageRules.description: Portainer CE stays on 2.x (3.x is the Business Edition); server and agent move together
prBodyNotes: Swarm stack: after merging run `make portainer`. Keep the server and the agent on the same version (docs/portainer.md).

Server and backup job (`kubernetes/services/vaultwarden/`) use the same image. Read the release notes: new Bitwarden clients often need a minimum server version, and some releases change settings. Argo CD deploys it on merge; the database migrates at start (Longhorn snapshot and the nightly dump are the way back, docs/vaultwarden.md).

packageRules.description: Forgejo stays on the 15.x LTS line (supported until July 2027); move to the next LTS by hand
prBodyNotes: Server and backup job (`kubernetes/services/forgejo/`) use the same image. Read the release notes (https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/releases) for changed settings. Argo CD deploys it on merge; the database migrates at start (the nightly dump and the Longhorn snapshot are the way back, docs/forgejo.md). Runner compatibility: docs/forgejo.md, "Upgrades".

packageRules.description: Forgejo Actions runner on runner-01 (role forgejo_runner)
prBodyNotes: Read the release notes (https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner/releases): majors change workflow behaviour and config keys. Put the SHA-256 of the GPG-verified binary into `forgejo_runner_sha256` (docs/forgejo-runner.md, "Upgrade"), then `make runner` after merging. Running jobs are cancelled by the restart.

Argo CD deploys it on merge; nothing is stored, so rolling back is reverting the PR. Read the release notes for changed settings or widget fields and for new config files (`kubernetes/services/homepage/config/`, docs/homepage.md). A widget that calls a new host or path needs an egress rule in `networkpolicy.yaml`.

Check the chart's changed values (`kubernetes/platform/metrics-server/values.yaml`: `defaultArgs` replaces the chart's list, `tls.type: cert-manager`) and the supported Kubernetes versions. After the sync: `kubectl get apiservice v1beta1.metrics.k8s.io` is Available and `kubectl top nodes` works.

restic on the Swarm nodes (role swarm_backup, checked against the release's SHA256SUMS) and the restic image of the Vaultwarden and Forgejo backup jobs (`kubernetes/services/{vaultwarden,forgejo}/backup.yaml`) move together: after merging run `make swarm-backup` (Argo CD updates the jobs). Read the changelog for repository format changes before merging.
lego on the Swarm managers (role edge, edge-cert; checked against the release's checksums file): after merging run `make edge`. Check the release notes for CLI changes (edge-cert calls `lego run`).
Argo CD upgrades itself from this Application; Ansible reads the same version for a fresh bootstrap.
